settings.heading: Textured planters with a hidden drip tray, printed in Lebanon.
settings.text: Quilt and Tile planters with matching vases, in four calm colours. Seven drainage holes, no saucer on show. From $14.
settings.note: Cash on delivery · Free delivery from $35

settings.title: Cash on delivery
settings.text: Pay the courier when it arrives

settings.heading: Two textures, four colours.
settings.text: Quilt or Tile, in Ivory White, Charcoal, Dark Green or Desert Tan. Pick a colour and add it straight to your cart.

settings.heading: How the water drains.
settings.text: Most decorative pots have no hole, so roots sit in water. Ours drain properly and still look clean on a shelf.
settings.note: Shown cut in half. Images are 3D renders; photos of the first prints are coming soon.

settings.title: Seven drainage holes
settings.text: A raised floor with seven holes lets extra water run straight through, so roots never sit wet.

settings.title: A hidden drip tray
settings.text: The water lands in a tray tucked under the skirt: about 70 ml on the medium pot, 45 ml on the small one.

settings.title: Twist off, empty, click back
settings.text: Twist the tray off to empty it after watering, then click it back on. No saucer, no puddles.

settings.heading: A medium planter and its matching vase.
settings.text: Pick a texture and a colour and we pack the two together. An easy housewarming gift.

settings.heading: A small 3D-printing studio in Lebanon.
settings.text: We draw every shape ourselves and print it layer by layer, 0.2 mm at a time, then check and pack each piece by hand. The fine lines are part of the texture.

settings.title: Quilt
settings.text: Soft diamond pillows that catch the light. Our most elegant texture.

settings.title: Tile
settings.text: A grid of soft squares, a nod to the cement-tile floors of old Beirut homes.

settings.heading: From our printer to your door.

settings.title: Order here or on WhatsApp
settings.text: No account needed. Just your name, phone and address.

settings.title: We pack it the same day
settings.text: Every piece is checked and wrapped by hand in Lebanon.

settings.title: At your door in 2 to 4 days
settings.text: Pay the courier in cash when it arrives. Delivery is $5, free from $35.

settings.question: Do you deliver everywhere in Lebanon?
settings.answer: Yes. Delivery takes 2 to 4 days and costs $5, free on orders from $35.

settings.question: How do I pay?
settings.answer: In cash when your order arrives. You don't need an account to order.

settings.question: Is the planter good for real plants?
settings.answer: Yes. Seven holes in a raised floor drain into a drip tray hidden under the pot. Twist the tray off to empty it after watering.

settings.question: Will my plant fit?
settings.answer: The small planter takes a nursery pot up to about 8 cm, the medium one up to about 10.5 cm. You can also plant straight in.

settings.question: Can the vase hold water?
settings.answer: It is made for dried or faux stems, because a printed vase isn't reliably watertight.

settings.question: What if something arrives damaged?
settings.answer: Send us a photo on WhatsApp within 48 hours of delivery and we print you a new one, free. No need to send the broken piece back.

settings.heading: Rather order by message?
settings.text: Send us the piece, size and colour on WhatsApp and we take it from there.
